features.name: cc_fraction_expression_any
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain a fraction expression such as 1/3, 2/5, one-half, two-thirds or three-quarters?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads; malformed/missing -> null; empty list -> 0. Return 1 if any comment string matches (case-insensitive) either numeric fraction regex r'(?<![\d/])\d{1,3}\s?/\s?\d{1,3}(?![\d/])' or word fraction regex r'\b(one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|a|an)[- ](half|halves|third|thirds|quarter|quarters|fourth|fourths|fifth|fifths|sixth|sixths|seventh|sevenths|eighth|eighths|ninth|ninths|tenth|tenths)\b' or r'\bhalf\b'. Else 0. Raw text match, no semantic filtering.

h0: cc_fraction_expression_any has no association with delta.
h1: Rows whose counter-arguments include a fraction expression (cc_fraction_expression_any=1) have higher odds/rate of delta than rows without.
note: Persuasiveness operationalized as OP delta at row level (association only). Comments are pooled per row; no per-comment outcomes. Regex may match non-fraction uses (dates, 'and/or'-like slashes, 'a half' idioms, scores) and misses other forms like '50%'. Raw text may contain post-outcome content; timing unknown. Numeric regex excludes slash chains but not dates like 1/3.
